measures.name: Headline Trend
measures.expression: VAR selectedFlow = SELECTEDVALUE('_Flow Parameter'[Parameter], "Total") RETURN SWITCH(selectedFlow, "Exports", [Total Exports (GBP bn)], "Imports", [Total Imports (GBP bn)], "Total", [Total Trade (GBP bn)], [Total Trade (GBP bn)])
measures.description: Report-level selector measure. Uses the existing _Flow Parameter labels to switch the headline trend among model exports, imports, and total trade measures.

measures.name: Balance State
measures.description: 0 is deficit and 1 is surplus; drives the headline card fill from the report theme.
